hooks.command: if [ -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/src" ]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 -m compileall -q src tests >&2 || exit 2; fi

python3 -c "import json,sys,os,fnmatch; p=os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))); h=os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser('~')); prot=[os.path.join(h,'.claude'),os.path.join(h,'.claude-accounts'),os.path.join(h,'.config','claude-switcher')]; b=fnmatch.fnmatch(os.path.basename(p),'.env*') or p==os.path.join(h,'.claude.json') or any(p==d or p.startswith(d+os.sep) for d in prot); b and print('Blocked: '+p+' is protected (shared Claude data, credentials or another tool); ask the user first', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(2 if b else 0)"

python3 -c "import json,sys,re; c=json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''); b=re.search(r'\bsecurity\b[^;&|]*\s-[a-zA-Z]*[wg][a-zA-Z]*\b',c) or re.search(r'\bCLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=',c); b and print('Blocked: printing Keychain secrets (security -w/-g) or setting CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is forbidden by docs/architecture.md', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(2 if b else 0)"
python3 -c "import json,sys; sys.exit(0 if json.load(sys.stdin).get('stop_hook_active') else 1)" || (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .) || exit 2
